title: Crispy Banana Fritters
description: A sweet Chinese dessert made with sliced bananas, deep-fried to perfection.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, and baking powder.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs and vanilla extract.
Add the yellow food coloring to the egg mixture and stir well.
Add the dry ingredients to the egg mixture and stir until just combined.
Peel the bananas and slice them into 1-inch pieces.
Dip each banana piece into the batter, coating it completely.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat.
When the oil is hot, add a few banana fritters to the pan (do not overcrowd).
Fry the banana fritters for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Remove the fritters from the oil with a slotted spoon and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the banana fritters warm and enjoy!
